answer.evidence: The entire object (rows 1-14) is drawn as a flat front elevation of a wall, consisting of an upper striped earthen/plaster wall and a lower grey stone base with a decorative cutout window. There is no visible top surface or roof slope showing depth in 3/4 perspective.
